title: Page 6
content_zh:
幸福的青鸟　千寻
大家好，我是千寻。
这是我的第三本书，蒋誉的故事，故事的主轴是青鸟，一只乐意为人们带来幸福的青鸟，折了翼、受了伤，仍然执意完成任务的青鸟。
她叫做跳眺。
说实话，这个名字对我来说很熟悉，我不记得在哪里听过，可是当这两个字在脑海里面成形，那个会跳舞的女生，那个把男主角当成生命重点的女孩，就「跳」出来了。
就这样，可爱的跳跳陪伴我走过无数个无眠夜。
我承认，自己一直是将女主角当成朋友对待的，她的苦、她的哀、她的痛、她的甜，总会不时在我胸口翻腾，一分舍不得、两分怜惜，到最后我常常觉得自己比男主角更珍惜女主角。
至于男主角，那是我抓不拢的部份，可能是身边的男生太少，所以不太懂他们的喜怒哀乐、想法和心情，只能纯粹臆测。
认真想想，好像从小到大，我身边的朋友都是女孩子居多，如果看过小茉莉那本书的后记，大概就会知道，原因和我的男性化很有关系。
我很高，个性很男生，却又比男人更具安慰人的技巧（也许和我修过心理谘商有关）。
所以到目前为止，伤心的、哀愁的朋友还是习惯靠在我的肩膀上落泪，我听着她们的悲苦、心境，听着她们的故事，一个个、一幕幕、一景景……
曾经猜过，我会选择写小说这份工作，是不是和她们有关系，因为我的肚子里，藏了太多女人的秘密。
我始终认为女人是用来疼的，男人是用来崇拜的，也许我的想法不甚正确，也许在这个飞机跑得比声音快的时代里已然落伍，但是我真的很想保有这份简单的甜美。
就让男人继续疼女人，就让女人继续以爱情做回韵，就让世界和平真善美，就让世间有喜无悲。
第1章(1)
美国华裔富豪商宗献 八成财产捐公益
婚礼席开百桌 富豪宣布捐款 全场宾客掌声响起 估金额逾百亿美金
美国电子业富豪商宗献，于日前迎娶英籍妻子。两人年纪相差三十二岁，当外界纷纷讨论年轻妻子能分得多少财产时，商宗献却与新婚妻子决定将财产的八成捐出来做公益……
据他表示，他不会留钱给独生女，对于女儿的教育栽培，他已经尽到身为父亲应尽的责任。
商宗献的女儿为知名舞蹈家商天雨，今年夏天雨夺下皇家舞蹈大赛芭蕾舞组冠军，是二十年来首位华裔舞者获奖，许多舞蹈家都给予极高的评价……

蒋誉阖上杂志，揉揉眉心，他对商宗献的捐款不感兴趣，感兴趣的是那个会跳舞的独生女。
商天雨，这个名字自他的生活中消失整整十个年头，一些尘封的、刻意被锁紧的陈旧记忆出笼，不安份地在他脑中闪现，一段、一场、一块，零零碎碎地，翻腾他平静无波的心。
「想什么？」他的秘书杜绢站在办公桌前，淡淡问他。
他长得还算不错，但双唇间经常噙着一丝冷笑，整个人微带着些许郁色。
事实上，蒋家兄弟在商场上赫赫有名，除了能力之外，长相也是重要的评分关键。他是四个兄弟里面唯一遗传到董事长鬈发的，不过也幸好是那头鬈发，稍稍柔和了他的五宫。
他的五官刚硬，加上时常出门见客的扑克牌脸，杂志上总说他是四个兄弟中最缺乏女人缘的，这句话并不夸张。
他的眼睛不大，但直勾勾盯住人时，锐利眼神绝对会让人害怕，他的脸型、鼻子不坏，但硬要她说出特色……说实话，她宁愿去形容蒋烲那棵人形桃花。
除了让人羡慕的一百九十公分身高之外，蒋誉全身上下最好看的是嘴巴，唇形是最完美的一百分，嘴唇颜色很红，看起来柔软可口，许多女人常在背后说：「亲吻他不知道是什么感觉？可以的话，我愿意付出任何代价换他一个吻。」
她也不知道吻他是什么感觉，虽然她是董事长内定的媳妇；虽然比起其他女人，她待在他身边最久；虽然蒋烲三番两次开玩笑叫她三嫂，而蒋誉即使听到也没有表态反对……
但她和他，到目前为止，关系仅止于总经理和秘书。
会和他结婚吗？她也不是太确定，对于婚姻，她不像其他女人那样积极，可能和她的爱情冷感症有关系吧。
蒋誉望向杜绢，她已经当他的秘书三年了。
她不是厉害能干的女人，可是她细心、体贴、温柔而且贤慧，是所有婆婆都会喜欢的超级媳妇型。
喜欢她吗？
至少不讨厌，她仔细而谨慎，有计划、有规律，能把他交代的事情做到最完美。当然，拿她和阿烲以前那个优秀精干的秘书詹沂婕相比，简直是天壤之别，没办法摆到同一个天秤上，但他的要求不多，跟她在一起，他很习惯也很……适应。
杜绢是能让男人觉得安心的女生，而且他百分百相信，有这种特质的女人，宜家宜室。
他想，他会跟她求婚，在下一次念头兴起的时候。
「有事吗？」他问。
她把行事历轻轻放到桌前，「这是你下星期的行程，有需要更改的部份，请提早告诉我，我马上变更。」
蒋誉翻了两下。「可以。」

「那么……你仍然坚持没有预约的话，不见任何人？」她问得小心。
这句话，她今天重复三遍了。杜绢知道，换成别人同样的话问三次，他绝对会摆臭脸，那功力和放恶犬吓人有异曲同工之妙。
「这个人，跟你有关系？」他丢给她疑问眼神。
「没有。」她坦荡荡地回答，她从不接受关说。
「你们之前认识？」
「不认识。」然而，整天相处下来，她承认，她喜欢那个小女生。
「为什么非要安排我们见面？」蒋誉的口气开始飙烂。
杜绢知道，他不耐烦了，对于女人，他都是不耐烦的。
「我只是佩服她的耐心。」
女孩坐在会客室里超过八个钟头，她在蒋誉未进公司之前就坐在那里等，等他开完会、等他见完客人，等他吃饱饭、谈合约……再二十分钟之后，他将会离开办公室，和自己出席一场慈善义卖会。
女孩很有风度地等待着，不吵不闹，也不给她压力，因为她说了，总经理不见没有事先预约的人。
女孩听进去了，笑笑说：「我知道啊，阿誉超讲原则的。没关系啦，我再等一下，说不定他临时取消某个行程，你再帮我排进去好不好？」
她拒绝不了女孩，只能点头。
可女孩的运气不好，今天所有行程都照表进行，没有疏漏。
女孩喝掉很多水，看掉很多本杂志，没离开过会客室，就连中午吃饭时间建议她去吃点东西，女孩还是摇头。「不行啊，要是我离开，阿誉突然有空怎么办？」
阿誉？她想他们是相熟的，不过，蒋誉的「原则」让她不敢擅自作主。
女孩身上穿着名牌、脖子上挂着Tiffany的项链，手上拎着名牌包包，连沙发旁边的旅行箱都是LV限量款，这么「高贵」的女生，她接待过好几位，但没有一个像她，客气有礼。
于是她忍不住问：「你叫什么名字？」
女孩说：「我叫商天雨，我不喜欢这个名字，天天下雨，听起来是不是很悲惨？」
杜绢同意。

商天雨说话的时候，眼睛灵活、表情生动，加上很多的手势动作，把她变成一幅美丽油画，而这幅油画上，是明明白白的晴天不是雨天。
content_en:
Happy Blue Bird Chihiro
Hello everyone, I am Qianxun.
This is my third book, the story of Jiang Yu. The main theme of the story is the blue bird, a blue bird that is willing to bring happiness to people. The blue bird has broken wings and is injured, but still insists on completing the task.
Her name is Tiao Tiao.
To be honest, this name is very familiar to me. I don’t remember where I heard it. But when these two words took shape in my mind, the girl who can dance, the girl who regards the male protagonist as the focus of her life, "jumped" out.
In this way, the lovely Jumping Dance accompanied me through countless sleepless nights.
I admit that I have always treated the heroine as a friend. Her bitterness, sorrow, pain, and sweetness will always churn in my chest from time to time, with one part reluctance and two parts pity. In the end, I often feel that I cherish the heroine more than the hero.
As for the male protagonist, that's the part that I couldn't grasp. Maybe it's because there are too few boys around me, so I don't know much about their joys, sorrows, thoughts and moods, so I can only make pure guesses.
Thinking about it carefully, it seems that since childhood, most of my friends have been girls. If you read the postscript of Xiao Moli's book, you will probably know that the reason has a lot to do with my masculinity.
I am very tall and have a very boyish personality, but I have more comforting skills than men (maybe it has something to do with my training in psychological counseling).
So up to now, sad and sorrowful friends are still used to leaning on my shoulder and crying. I listen to their sorrow, state of mind, and their stories, one by one, scene by scene, scene by scene...
I once wondered whether my choice of writing novels had something to do with them, because I had too many women’s secrets hidden in my belly.
I have always believed that women are meant for pain and men are meant for worship. Maybe my idea is not correct, and maybe it is outdated in this era when airplanes run faster than the sound, but I really want to keep this simple sweetness.
Let men continue to love women, let women continue to respond with love, let the world be peaceful, truthful, good and beautiful, and let the world be happy but not sad.
Chapter 1(1)
Chinese-American billionaire Shang Zongxian donates 80% of his wealth to charity
Hundreds of wedding tables were opened, the rich man announced a donation, and the guests applauded, the amount is estimated to be more than 10 billion US dollars
Businessman Zongxian, a tycoon in the American electronics industry, recently married his British wife. There is a thirty-two-year age difference between the two. When the outside world is discussing how much property the young wife can get, Shang Zongxian and his newlywed wife decided to donate 80% of the property to charity...
According to him, he will not leave any money to his only daughter, and he has fulfilled his responsibilities as a father for his daughter's education and cultivation.
Shang Zongxian’s daughter is the well-known dancer Shang Tianyu. This year Xia Yu won the championship in the ballet category of the Royal Dance Competition. She was the first Chinese dancer to win the award in 20 years. Many dancers have given high praise...
Jiang Yu closed the magazine and rubbed his eyebrows. He was not interested in Shang Zongxian's donation. He was interested in the only daughter who could dance.
Shang Tianyu, this name disappeared from his life for ten years. Some dusty and deliberately locked old memories came out of the cage and flashed restlessly in his mind. Pieces, scenes, pieces, piecemeal, stirred up his calm heart.
"What are you thinking about?" His secretary Du Juan stood in front of his desk and asked him calmly.
He looks pretty good, but he often has a sneer on his lips, and his whole person is slightly gloomy.
In fact, the Jiang brothers are well-known in the shopping mall. In addition to ability, appearance is also an important scoring key. He was the only one among the four brothers who inherited the chairman's curly hair, but fortunately, the curly hair slightly softened his fifth palace.
With his hard features and poker face that often went out to meet guests, magazines always said that he was the least attractive to women among the four brothers. This was no exaggeration.
His eyes are not big,But when staring directly at someone, his sharp eyes will definitely frighten people. His face shape and nose are not bad, but if she is forced to name his characteristics... To be honest, she would rather describe Jiang Xuan's human-shaped peach blossom.
In addition to his enviable height of 190 centimeters, the most beautiful thing about Jiang Yu is his mouth. The shape of his lips is 100% perfect. The color of his lips is very red and they look soft and delicious. Many women often say behind his back: "I wonder what it feels like to kiss him? If possible, I would pay any price for a kiss from him."
She didn't know what it felt like to kiss him, even though she was the chairman's default wife; even though she stayed with him the longest compared to other women; even though Jiang Ye joked about calling her third sister-in-law again and again, and Jiang Yu didn't object even if he heard it...
But her relationship with him so far has only limited to the general manager and secretary.
Will you marry him? She is not too sure. She is not as positive about marriage as other women, which may have something to do with her love apathy.
Jiang Yu looked at Du Juan. She had been his secretary for three years.
She is not a very capable woman, but she is careful, considerate, gentle and wise. She is a super daughter-in-law type that all mothers-in-law will like.
Do you like her?
At least she's not annoying. She's careful and cautious, planned and regular, and can do everything he tells her to the best. Of course, comparing her with Zhan Yijie, Ah Xuan's former excellent and capable secretary, they were so different that they couldn't be put on the same scale, but he didn't have many requirements, and he was very used to and...adapted to being with her.
Du Juan is a girl who can make men feel at ease, and he 100% believes that a woman with this quality is like IKEA IKEA.
He thought he would propose to her the next time the idea struck him.
"Is something wrong?" he asked.
She gently put the calendar on the table, "This is your itinerary for next week. If there are any parts that need to be changed, please tell me in advance and I will change them immediately."
Jiang Yu turned over it twice. "Okay."
"So...you still insist on not seeing anyone without an appointment?" She asked carefully.
She repeated this sentence three times today. Du Juan knew that if he asked someone the same thing three times, he would definitely put on a bad face. His skill was similar to letting a vicious dog scare people.
"Does this person have anything to do with you?" He gave her a questioning look.
"No." She answered frankly. She never accepted any explanation.
"Have you met before?"
"I don't know him." However, after spending the whole day together, she admitted that she liked that little girl.
"Why do you have to arrange for us to meet?" Jiang Yu's tone started to get louder.
Du Juan knew that he was impatient. He was impatient with women.
"I just admire her patience."
The girl sat in the reception room for more than eight hours. She sat there waiting before Jiang Yuwei entered the company, waiting for him to finish the meeting, wait for him to meet the guests, wait for him to have a full meal and negotiate the contract... In another twenty minutes, he would leave the office and attend a charity bazaar with her.
The girl waited in a very graceful manner, without making any noise or putting pressure on her, because she said that the general manager would not see anyone who did not make a reservation in advance.
The girl listened and smiled and said, "I know, A Yuchao is very principled. It doesn't matter. I'll wait a little longer. Maybe he cancels a certain trip at short notice. Can you help me arrange it?"
She couldn't refuse the girl, so she could only nod.
But the girl was unlucky. Today, all the itinerary went according to the schedule, without any omissions.
The girl drank a lot of water, read a lot of magazines, and never left the living room. Even when it was suggested to her to eat something during lunch time, the girl still shook her head. "No, what if I leave and Ayu suddenly becomes free?"
Ayu? She thought they were familiar with each other, but Jiang Yu's "principles" prevented her from making decisions without authorization.
girl wearing brand name, with a Tiffany necklace hanging around her neck, a brand-name bag in her hand, and even the suitcase next to the sofa is a LV limited edition. She has received several such "noble" girls, but none of them are as polite and polite as her.
So she couldn't help but ask: "What's your name?"
The girl said: "My name is Shang Tianyu. I don't like this name. It rains every day. Doesn't it sound miserable?"
Du Juan agreed.
When Shang Tianyu spoke, her eyes were flexible, her expressions were vivid, and she added many gestures and movements, turning her into a beautiful oil painting. In this oil painting, it was clearly a sunny day, not a rainy day.
